svg.title: EAFAMS Admin Portal Master Architecture (R1-R7)
svg.desc: Comprehensive system architecture and dataflow across MOE HQ, School Users, Core Processing Engines, and Government Services
svg.text: EAFAMS ADMIN PORTAL // COMPLETE 7-MODULE ARCHITECTURE & RBAC TOPOLOGY

g.text: • Daily 00:00 SGT Sync: Auto-open EA for Singaporean age 7
• Backend-Triggered Check: Auto-close at 16y or lost SC
Initial Bal: $0.00 | Closure: CPF Transfer / Deferred
• Bulk Campaign: Filter (Age + Balance + Schooling) & Budget
• Class Assignment -> Enrolment Profile -> Auto-link SC EA
• Fee Rate Rules: Stages (P1-JC2) × Resident (SC/PR/IS) + GST
• Fee Publication -> Resolve Cohort -> Student Charges (POSTED)
• MOEFAS: Auto-Grant if SC & (GHI <=$4,000 OR PCI <=$1,000)
• SBFAS: School Admin Review Drawer with ML Need Score
• ML AI Recommendation: Need Score (0-100) + Risk Tiering
Net Payable = Original Amount - Subsidy Amount
• Auto-match: NRIC -> Parent/Child Lock, Gov Income Autofill
• Submit -> Split Family Unit into Child Apps (FAM-YYYY-NNNNN)
• Auto-decrement on Grant; Depletion -> Insufficient Budget
Analytics: Scheme, Stage, Class & Tier Breakdown
